rationale: Price has sold off from 16.39 to the 30% mark of the daily range yet sits just above session VWAP (15.80) and the 9-EMA (15.77). The final 1-minute candle exploded to 88k shares—more than 20× the volume of each of the prior four minutes—printing a higher high and higher low while closing near its high at 15.82. This mechanical surge in demand after the low-volume consolidation supplies the long thesis; a break below the candle's 15.77 low invalidates it.
